answer: Tie every identity's stake to its funding source: each identity posts collateral, but the required bond multiplies with every other identity funded from the same wallet — one identity posts a single marble, ten identities each post ten. A lone honest agent pays once, while a farm of clones faces a timber wall of escalating bonds that grows faster than its headcount. Funding is public on-chain, so a clone hiding its backer must find a fresh, wealthy funder, and one caught clone exposes the whole funded cluster to slashing at once — the zenith of cost lands on the operator, not the honest agent.
